title: Target Registry
$comment: @akili-spec changes/cicd-executor-poc requirements FR-02; design 7.7 (amended 2026-10-05), DD-21, DD-23 (Forma versionada). Map of targetId -> entry. Every entry carries only logical identifiers and references (DD-23): connectionRef/hostKeyRef/imageRepositoryRef, never inline host/port/user/credential/secret values — additionalProperties:false at every level means an inline field such as `password` or `privateKey` is rejected as an unrecognized property. `deployWindowPolicy` and the external-deployers declaration have NO default (requirements FR-02 scenario 'politica de ventana obligatoria'): both are mandatory on every entry. The two valid, mutually exclusive shapes (design 7.7 'Forma versionada DD-23', amended 2026-10-05) are expressed as oneOf: externalDeployersRef present => deployWindowPolicy MUST be 'required' (and only 'required' — this is the ONLY shape that may declare `required`, since a resolved, non-empty external-deployers list is what a deploy window protects); externalDeployers literal 'none' present => deployWindowPolicy MUST be 'not-required'. Per the amended design 7.7 table, `none` and `not-required` are logically equivalent (an empty external-deployers list REQUIRES `not-required`, and `not-required` REQUIRES an empty list) and neither oneOf branch admits `required` + `none` — that combination is invalid by construction (owner-approved ruling, execution.md 2026-10-05): a window must cover a non-empty list of external deployers, so a target with none declared could never satisfy a `required` policy. `migrationCompatibility`/`attestedBy` are required together, only when the `migration` block (migrations enabled) is present (design DD-11).

logicalRef.$comment: Publication policy (DD-23, 4.1): a reference only, never a real value.

containerName.$comment: Logical container name: either an angle-bracket placeholder or a semantic id. Never a real container name.

migrationCompatibility.$comment: requirements FR-13 precondition / design DD-11: the ONLY accepted value. A target with migrations enabled and no (or any other) value here is an invalid definition.

attestedBy.$comment: Who attests backward compatibility (application team, not the platform — design DD-11: 'la plataforma must NOT presentar esa propiedad como garantizada').

targetEntry.$comment: design 7.7 (amended 2026-10-05): with a resolved-list reference ⇒ deployWindowPolicy MUST be 'required'; externalDeployers: none ⇔ deployWindowPolicy: not-required. required + none is invalid (owner ruling, execution.md 2026-10-05) because a window can only cover a non-empty external-deployers list.
